label: LDP
notes: LDP PDU header (RFC 5036 §3.1.1) over TCP port 646, the LDP session channel; base 20 assumes a TCP header without options. Discovery hellos ride the same PDU inside UDP port 646 multicasts, but their byte offsets hang off a UDP header, so this entry anchors at TCP only. The 10-byte PDU header is modelled in full: version, PDU length, and the LDP Identifier split into the 4-byte LSR Id — an address-like identifier carried in the payload, where host primitives cannot reach it, so it is a first-class ipv4 field — and the 2-byte label space number. Messages (message id plus typed TLVs: hello, initialisation, keepalive, address and label mappings) follow with variable length and offsets.

fields.label: PDU Length
fields.description: Total length of this PDU excluding the version and PDU length fields.

fields.label: LSR Id
fields.description: First 4 bytes of the LDP Identifier: the LSR Id of the router sending the PDU.

fields.label: Label Space
fields.description: Second half of the LDP Identifier; 0 identifies the per-platform label space.
